summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted with severe hyperglycemia in the setting of dexamethasone therapy for a pathologic spinal fracture related to multiple myeloma. His blood glucose reached the 400s despite adherence to his home insulin regimen. He also presented with acute kidney injury, likely due to volume depletion, and a history of recurrent falls attributed to diabetic neuropathy and deconditioning from a prior prolonged hospitalization. During admission, his blood sugar improved with insulin adjustment and his renal function normalized with IV fluids. An endocrinology recommendation was implemented to increase his basal and bolus insulin on steroid days. He remained stable, with no infectious complications, and was discharged home with physical therapy for fall prevention and plans for outpatient follow-up with his endocrinologist, oncologist, and primary care provider.
